title: Roles with Rails: Contract-Preserving Role Evolution in Multi-Agent Structured Reasoning
problem: Adaptive multi-agent role pools can lose necessary capabilities and break coordination or answer-format contracts.
assumption_broken: Role inventories can evolve rather than remain fixed if structural obligations are explicitly protected.
operational_signature: Retrieve → coordinate → attribute → propose → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Contract-masked, credit-guided role edits persist only when they preserve five structural contracts and improve task scores.

improver_modified.how: A lightweight contextual-bandit controller learns which role-pool edit to propose using REINFORCE.

limitations_evident: Text-only automatically scored benchmarks
Hand-designed seed role families
Incomplete end-to-end training-cost accounting

title: BenchTrace: A Benchmark for Testing Reflection Ability and Controlled Evolution in LLM Agents
problem: Outcome-only evaluations cannot isolate reflection quality or control which failures drive agent evolution.
assumption_broken: Self-evolution evaluation need not depend on each agent's independently generated failure history.
operational_signature: Collect → annotate → expose → resume → measure
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled signal-and-noise snapshot sequences isolate whether prior failure reflections prevent a matched target failure.
limitations_evident: Limited snapshots cannot support parametric evolution
Structured environments rather than open-ended real-world tasks
GPT-4.1 evaluated on only two tasks

title: Compute Allocation for Self-Evolving LLMs: From Depth-Breadth to Multi-Armed Bandits
problem: Fixed-budget evolutionary search is unreliable because compute can be wasted on weak trajectories.
assumption_broken: Compute allocation across search trajectories can be optimized independently of the model, prompt, and evaluator.
operational_signature: Initialize → propose → score → allocate → refine → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: A multi-armed bandit adaptively directs a fixed LLM-call budget among independent evolutionary trajectories.
limitations_evident: Three geometric optimization tasks
Allocation cannot overcome model capability limits
Baseline prompts differ in task-specific hints

title: SkillBrew: Multi-Objective Curation of Skill Banks for LLM Agents
problem: Append-only skill banks accumulate redundant or harmful skills that impair retrieval and task success.
assumption_broken: A skill bank should be optimized globally rather than expanded or scored one skill at a time.
operational_signature: Retrieve → replay → diagnose → edit → compare → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Counterfactual skill attribution guides bank edits verified by utility-constrained Pareto selection over utility, diversity, and coverage.
limitations_evident: Repeated leave-one-out rollouts remain expensive
Frozen worker excludes joint policy-bank adaptation
Assumes relatively static task distributions

title: GRASP: Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: New procedural guidance can fix a failure while silently regressing previously correct behavior.
assumption_broken: Skill accumulation is not inherently beneficial and should be reversible and regression-constrained.
operational_signature: Group → contrast → propose → replay → gate → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: Candidate edits to a bounded skill library require positive net fixes on a balanced probe under a hard regression budget.
limitations_evident: Probe validation dominates training compute
Transfer degrades under tool-interface mismatch
Open-ended action spaces show little benefit

title: Evolve as a Team: Collaborative Self-Evolution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Centralized analysis of long interleaved multi-agent traces loses the local detail needed for reliable failure attribution.
assumption_broken: The agents that execute a task can collaboratively diagnose and evolve their own team rather than rely on a single external analyzer.
operational_signature: Execute → preserve → exchange → diagnose → revise → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Post-task cross-agent communication connects preserved local contexts to update individual scaffolds, teammate profiles, and team organization.
limitations_evident: Evolution sets contain only around twenty examples per benchmark
Main evaluation uses one backbone
Collaborative evolution requires additional communication

title: EvoRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric-Driven RL for Open-Ended Generation
problem: Open-ended generation lacks verifiable correctness targets for learning useful adaptive evaluation criteria.
assumption_broken: Rubric construction can be learned jointly with response generation instead of supplied by fixed or external criteria.
operational_signature: Generate → differentiate → verify → compare → remember → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint GRPO training rewards valid, discriminative, peer-consistent rubric discovery while persistent rubric memory supplies evolving response supervision.

improver_modified.how: The shared policy is explicitly trained in both Reasoner and Rubric Generator roles.

limitations_evident: Separate policy trained for each domain
Frozen model verifier retains residual invalid criteria
Human comparisons reveal completeness trade-offs

title: EvoRepair: Enhancing Vulnerability Repair Agents Through Experience-Based Self-Evolution
problem: Vulnerability repair agents repeat mistakes because they do not accumulate and reuse repair experience.
assumption_broken: Repair knowledge can persist and improve across vulnerabilities instead of being discarded after each repair.
operational_signature: Retrieve → repair → extract → score → update → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A quality-scored experience bank is updated from repair trajectories and retrieved to guide subsequent repairs.
limitations_evident: Evaluation centers on automated vulnerability repair

title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit: Disentangling Evolution Capabilities in Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: End-to-end evolution scores conflate producing useful harness updates with successfully using them.
assumption_broken: Stronger task-solving models need not be better harness updaters or derive larger gains from evolved harnesses.
operational_signature: Pair → execute → inspect → update → reuse → disentangle
load_bearing_mechanism: Crossing fixed task-solving agents with different evolver models separates update quality from harness-use capability.
limitations_evident: In-situ stream evaluation rather than frozen held-out artifact evaluation
Only non-parametric harness adaptation
Limited model-family and capability grid

title: ExpHarness: Model-Agnostic Experience Learning through a Trainable Harness
problem: Frozen executors cannot reliably exploit prior experience using similarity-only, task-invariant retrieval.
assumption_broken: Experience learning can reside in a trainable external harness while the executor remains frozen and replaceable.
operational_signature: Distill → link → control → retrieve → compare → update
load_bearing_mechanism: A PPO-trained retrieval copilot controls graph exploration and utility weighting using with-versus-without-experience task rewards.

improver_modified.how: PPO updates the copilot that determines retrieval breadth and utility preference.

limitations_evident: Shared set-level reward does not isolate individual experience utility
Transfer figure lacks target no-memory reference
Interaction steps omit training and retrieval costs

title: Detect in Any Scene: An Agentic Framework for Object Detection with Experience-Aware Reasoning
problem: Fixed restoration-detection pipelines fail under heterogeneous degradations and object distributions.
assumption_broken: Restoration and detector choices should vary per image and may bypass enhancement when it harms detection.
operational_signature: Profile → explore → score → aggregate → retrieve → compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Node-level ground-truth detection statistics indexed by fine-grained scene profiles guide restoration, super-resolution, and detector selection.
limitations_evident: MLLM detectors trail conventional detectors in fixed scenes
Limited restoration and detector toolbox
No infrared, X-ray, or medical imaging evaluation

title: LLM-Driven Co-Evolutionary Automated Heuristic Design for Bi-Component Coupled Combinatorial Optimization
problem: Independently evolved heuristics miss the interactions between coupled solution components.
assumption_broken: An operator's utility is relational to its partner rather than an intrinsic standalone fitness.
operational_signature: Initialize → pair → execute → score → prune → recombine
load_bearing_mechanism: Cooperative full-objective evaluation and synergy-guided joint crossover co-evolve complementary component-operator populations.
limitations_evident: Only two coupled decision components
Larger TTP instances trail CoCo
Uses trusted problem-specific repair and evaluation tools

title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
problem: Cold-start LLM-authored skills can be well formed but behaviorally ineffective without execution-grounded repair.
assumption_broken: Useful skill refinement need not await a large accumulated trajectory corpus or expert-authored skills.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose → retrieve → anchor → revise → recheck → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Diagnosis-bound repair principles induce executable behavioral edits that are re-run and selected by measured utility.
limitations_evident: Visible verifier checks can be overfit
Extra executions required for repair
Transfer study restricted to source-success subset

title: ANDES: Agent Native Data Evolving Synthesis Tool for Autonomous Instruction Alignment
problem: Autonomous post-training agents struggle to obtain targeted, diverse, high-quality data within limited context and compute.
assumption_broken: Data acquisition can be an interactive agent-native synthesis skill rather than web curation or a static generation script.
operational_signature: Abstract → route → expand → synthesize → diagnose → steer → train
load_bearing_mechanism: An expanding weighted World Tree and diagnostic reports let a trainer agent steer targeted data synthesis away from repetitive reasoning templates.
limitations_evident: Main trainer uses one backbone
Data quality and diversity judged by LLMs
Specialized scaffold contributes materially to gains

title: SkillSmith: Co-Evolving Skills and Tools for Self-Improving Agent Systems
problem: Skill-only evolution wastes finite context on duplicated tool logic and repeats rejected modifications.
assumption_broken: The boundary between contextual skills and executable tools is an optimization variable, not fixed infrastructure.
operational_signature: Mask → estimate → allocate → localize → migrate → validate → remember
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed atomic skill-tool edits free context while interaction-aware allocation and version-scoped failure nogoods conserve execution and search budgets.
limitations_evident: Sparse skill-interaction exposure limits estimation
Depends on posterior calibration and reflection quality
Fixed-model guarantees do not ensure sampled-update improvement

title: MobEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolving Heuristic System for Interpretable Human Mobility Generation
problem: Mobility generators struggle to combine behavioral plausibility, distribution alignment, interpretability, and scalable inference.
assumption_broken: Interpretable mobility heuristics can be automatically revised rather than remain manually fixed.
operational_signature: Generate → compare → attribute → edit → verify → record
load_bearing_mechanism: A coding agent converts validation-set distributional and behavioral failures into verified edits of four interpretable mobility components.
limitations_evident: Two cities and daily hourly trip chains only
Reference data may underrepresent rare population patterns
Targeted revisions may overfit validation feedback

title: Adaptive Auto-Harness: Sustained Self-Improvement for Agentic System Deployment on Open-Ended Task Streams
problem: A single densely evolving harness degrades on growing, heterogeneous, non-stationary task streams.
assumption_broken: Deployment improvement requires both constructing harness capabilities and selecting task-specific harnesses rather than repeatedly rewriting one universal state.
operational_signature: Reveal → analyze → research → build → verify → branch → route
load_bearing_mechanism: A stateful multi-agent evolver constructs specialized harness branches that a solve-time router selects per incoming task.
limitations_evident: Only three deployment streams evaluated
Oracle loss components are not directly estimated
Routing can hurt when source acquisition dominates

title: HarnessForge: Joint Harness and Policy Evolution for Adaptive Agent Systems
problem: Separately optimizing harnesses and policies leaves executors unable to reliably follow evolved interfaces.
assumption_broken: The unit of adaptation should be a compatible harness-policy pair rather than either component alone.
operational_signature: Profile → attribute → tailor → filter → curate → align → evolve
load_bearing_mechanism: Fault-guided Pareto harness search alternates with harness-conditioned LoRA alignment on reused successful rollouts.
limitations_evident: Only Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B tested
Repeated long-horizon rollouts remain costly
Constrained edits exclude arbitrary harness implementations

title: MetaForge: A Self-Evolving Multimodal Agent that Retrieves, Adapts, and Forges Tools On Demand
problem: Static tool inventories miss novel needs while indiscriminate calls add noise and latency.
assumption_broken: An agent can choose to answer directly, reuse tools, or synthesize reusable tools rather than operate within a fixed inventory.
operational_signature: Decide → retrieve → adapt → forge → validate → recycle
load_bearing_mechanism: Multi-turn GRPO jointly rewards correct, efficient tool orchestration and validated tool forging and reuse.

improver_modified.how: GRPO trains the orchestration policy's decisions to invoke, forge, and reuse tools.

limitations_evident: Forged scripts cannot supply missing external models or resources
Evaluation limited to image-text tasks
Efficiency objective omits monetary and context costs

title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
problem: Agentic image generation relies on costly priors and rigid tool choices while ignoring inference cost.
assumption_broken: Tool capability knowledge can be discovered autonomously and used to select the cheapest generator meeting a quality threshold.
operational_signature: Propose → generate → evaluate → summarize → prune → route
load_bearing_mechanism: Prerequisite-pruned concept exploration builds empirical tool profiles for stateful quality-constrained cost-minimizing routing.
limitations_evident: Capability knowledge depends on model-based image scoring
Higher quality thresholds increase latency
Limited to text-to-image generation

title: MMG2Skill: Can Agents Distill In-the-Wild Guides into Self-Evolving Skills?
problem: Human-oriented multimodal guides lack runtime grounding and cannot reliably guide agent execution as raw context.
assumption_broken: Public guides can become editable executable skills revised from visible trajectories without benchmark-score feedback.
operational_signature: Compile → execute → diagnose → revise → retry → stop
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-level root-cause diagnoses localize guide-runtime mismatches into persistent skill edits with analyzer-based early stopping.
limitations_evident: Assumes a task-relevant guide is already supplied
Outcome inference unreliable with hidden information
Multimodal rollouts and repeated revision are expensive

title: Better with Experience: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Evidence-Grounded Health Community Notes
problem: One-pass health correction systems discard reusable evidence-seeking and note-writing experience.
assumption_broken: Each flagged post can improve future correction strategies rather than remain an isolated generation episode.
operational_signature: Analyze → retrieve → investigate → write → judge → distill
load_bearing_mechanism: Health-specific utility feedback is assigned to action phases and distilled into trigger-conditioned memories retrieved at subsequent decision points.
limitations_evident: LLM utility judgment is not real-world crowd approval
Incorrect memories may propagate flawed health guidance
Captioning can lose visual details

title: Traj-Evolve: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Patient Trajectory Modeling in Lung Cancer Early Detection
problem: Static EHR reasoning agents process each patient independently without learning from verified prior cases.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent temporal reasoning can improve through both retrieved patient experience and parameter updates.
operational_signature: Sample → verify → retain → retrieve → decompose → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Label-conditioned experience retrieval and reward-ranked worker-manager fine-tuning are unified through leave-one-out cross-retrieval.
limitations_evident: Single-institution retrospective case-control cohort
Correct final labels do not verify intermediate reasoning
Clinical outcome labels may be delayed or noisy

title: SkillDAG: Self-Evolving Typed Skill Graphs for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
problem: Flat or fixed-pipeline retrieval omits prerequisites and co-selects redundant or conflicting skills.
assumption_broken: Inter-skill relations can be queried and revised by the acting agent rather than consumed by an opaque retriever.
operational_signature: Query → inspect → execute → propose → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: An agent-callable typed graph accumulates execution-backed relations through reversible commits constrained by acyclicity and non-contradiction.
limitations_evident: Single-observation edits lack semantic confidence gates
Long-horizon graph corruption remains untested
Recall monotonicity assumes an untruncated retrieval union

title: PhotoCraft: Agentic Reasoning with Hierarchical Self-Evolving Memory for Deep Image Search
problem: Stateless search agents lose constraints during long reasoning chains and cannot reuse successful strategies across queries.
assumption_broken: Agent memory can preserve precise execution state while abstracting reusable strategies rather than merely compressing conversation history.
operational_signature: Search → preserve → audit → distill → merge → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Fidelity-guarded working memory and reflective audits feed a success-filtered semantic skill library that guides subsequent searches.
limitations_evident: Evaluation limited to 122 DISBench queries
Skill coverage depends on successful historical episodes
Successful-trajectory filtering requires final F1 feedback

title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
problem: Static training diagnostics and scalar recipe search cannot distinguish shifting RL bottlenecks from invalid high-scoring behaviors.
assumption_broken: The diagnostic infrastructure and intervention procedures guiding training can evolve alongside the policy being trained.
operational_signature: Train → diagnose → revise → backtest → promote → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Versioned empirical interventions jointly revise policies and the trainer's diagnostic harness while retaining reusable skills and negative evidence.

improver_modified.how: The trainer revises its metrics, analyzers, diagnostic procedures, and reusable skill library across training versions.

limitations_evident: Single training seed per version
Costly or consequential actions require human approval
Only seven to ten retained versions per domain

title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution
problem: Isolated agents lack diverse experience while sharing raw trajectories and a uniform skill library compromises privacy and personalization.
assumption_broken: Collaborative evolution can exchange semantic library patches and personalize their absorption instead of sharing raw trajectories or global model weights.
operational_signature: Execute → distill → exchange → model → personalize → apply
load_bearing_mechanism: A server infers client capability boundaries from semantic skill diffs and rewrites peer lessons into personalized libraries.
limitations_evident: Assumes trusted clients without poisoned patches
Only a modest number of concurrent clients evaluated
Cross-model and cross-harness transfer sometimes regresses

title: EvoMemNav: Efficient Self-Evolving Fine-Grained Memory for Zero-Shot Embodied Navigation
problem: Navigation memories discard fine-grained visual evidence and fail to reuse prior verification and exploration outcomes.
assumption_broken: A navigation graph can preserve raw visual evidence and adapt its decision priors without model retraining or dense reconstruction.
operational_signature: Observe → organize → shortlist → verify → update → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Budgeted coarse-to-fine retrieval over an image-grounded graph is refined by scene-persistent outcome statistics attached to rooms, views, and frontiers.
limitations_evident: Persistent priors are scene-specific
Ablation and runtime analysis use one episode per scene
Verification feedback may reinforce VLM judgment errors

title: SAGE: A Quantitative Evaluation of Socialized Evolution in Agent Ecosystems
problem: Isolated self-improvement evaluations cannot identify when public peer experience adds value beyond additional attempts.
assumption_broken: Access to peer histories is an experimental variable rather than a universally beneficial source of improvement.
operational_signature: Attempt → publish → filter → abstract → reuse → compare
load_bearing_mechanism: Compute-matched social and self-evolution conditions isolate the effects of peer-history visibility and representation.
limitations_evident: Fixed five-model population
Shared histories are context-budget bounded
Abstract and detailed results disagree about opponent-specific adaptation

title: EvoDrive: Pareto Evolution for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving via Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Adversarial driving scenario generation collapses attack-realism trade-offs and wastes expensive simulator evaluations on implausible proposals.
assumption_broken: Scenario generator mechanisms and evaluation routing can evolve within locked simulator interfaces rather than fixed scalarized heuristics.
operational_signature: Propose → critique → repair → route → simulate → archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Simulator-grounded bounded generator edits are critic-filtered and evaluator-routed before Pareto archiving preserves diverse attack-realism improvements.

improver_modified.how: The world evaluator updates from earlier simulation labels to improve subsequent candidate routing.

limitations_evident: Evolution assumes fixed ego policies
Validation is simulation-only
Finite simulator budgets may miss rare failure modes
